name: online payments
label: Online payments

modes.title: Card payments declined
modes.symptom: valid cards being declined on the payment page
customer_says: I'm trying to pay my bill online and it keeps declining my card. The card works everywhere else.
Your payment page says payment declined. My bank says they never even saw the request.
I can't pay my bill. I've tried two different cards and both get refused.
The online payment keeps failing with card not accepted. There's plenty of money in the account.

causes.cause: a lapsed merchant credential at the card processor
fixes: renewing the merchant credential at the card processor

causes.cause: a fraud screening rule that rejected every transaction
fixes: switching off the faulty fraud screening rule

causes.cause: a broken connection to the card authorisation network
fixes: re-establishing the connection to the card authorisation network

workarounds: pay by bank transfer using the reference on the bill
pay over the automated phone line, which uses a different processor
aftercare: try the card payment again from the billing page
disregard any late payment reminder issued during the fault

modes.title: Payments taken twice
customer_says: You've taken my bill payment twice. I paid once and there are two charges on my card.
I've been charged double for this month. My banking app shows the same amount going out twice.
I made one payment online, and it has come out of my account two times.
There are two identical payments to Meridian on my statement, and I only pressed pay once.

causes.cause: a retry setting that resubmitted completed payments
fixes: disabling the retry setting and reversing the repeated payments

causes.cause: a settlement file that was processed twice
fixes: reversing the second run of the settlement file

causes.cause: a timeout between the payment page and the ledger service
fixes: reconciling the ledger service against the processor's records

workarounds: hold off making further card payments until the repeat charges are reversed
ask the bank to dispute the second charge if the money is needed urgently
aftercare: allow three to five working days for the refund to show on the card
check the next bill to confirm that only one payment was applied

modes.title: Payments not showing on accounts
modes.symptom: completed payments not appearing on account balances
customer_says: I paid my bill and my account still says it's overdue.
The money has left my bank, but the Meridian account shows nothing paid.
My payment went through, and I have the receipt, but the balance hasn't moved.
I keep getting reminders for a bill I've already paid online.

causes.cause: a posting job that stalled on the accounts ledger
a mismatch in the reference format after a billing update
fixes: reprocessing payments with the corrected reference format

causes.cause: a queue of payment confirmations stuck at the processor
fixes: releasing the stuck queue of payment confirmations

workarounds: keep the payment receipt and ignore reminder messages for now
quote the receipt number to an adviser so a hold can be placed on the account
aftercare: check the balance in the portal after the next overnight update
contact us with the receipt number if the payment has still not appeared

modes.title: Direct debit set-up failing
modes.symptom: direct debit set-up forms being rejected on submission
customer_says: I'm trying to set up a direct debit online, and the form refuses my bank details.
The direct debit page won't accept my account number. It is definitely correct.
Setting up automatic payments fails at the last step with an unhelpful error.
I can't switch to direct debit. The website says my bank details cannot be verified.

causes.cause: a bank account checking service that was unreachable
fixes: restoring the link to the bank account checking service

causes.cause: a sort code directory that had not been refreshed
fixes: loading the current sort code directory

causes.cause: a form validation script that rejected every account number
fixes: deploying a corrected form validation script

workarounds: set up the direct debit by phone with an adviser
make a one-off card payment this month and set up the direct debit afterwards
aftercare: submit the direct debit form again
look out for the confirmation letter, which arrives within ten days

wrong_customer_side: a spending limit set by the bank
a billing address that does not match the card
a browser that blocks the card security pop-up
wrong_provider_side: a bank holiday delaying all payments
an upgrade to the billing system
a fault at the cardholder's bank
a change of payment provider this month
